items.title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
items.excerpt: Nicalis pulled AI-generated music from a GTA 6-themed mode in The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players exposed it and review-bombed the update; creator Edmund McMillen says he 'had no idea' AI music had been used.
items.rationale: Clear lesson on disclosure: undisclosed AI audio in a major indie hit led to review-bombing and removal, and the creator distanced himself. Single card for the c0 cluster (The Verge over IGN/Eurogamer), assigned to games only by the brief.

items.title: Wizards of the Coast to pass full AI copyright payout to D&D writers
items.excerpt: Wizards of the Coast says it will pass its full share of the Anthropic AI copyright settlement for D&D books on to the writers who created them.
items.rationale: A concrete publisher decision on who gets AI-training compensation. This sets a precedent that game writers and designers can point to in their contracts.

items.title: Activision Patent Would Let AI NPCs Learn From Toxic COD Lobbies
items.excerpt: A newly surfaced Activision patent describes training AI-driven NPCs on players' Call of Duty voice chat so enemies can learn to trash-talk like real players.
items.rationale: Shows where a major publisher is taking AI NPC design: behaviour learned from player voice data. It raises data-consent and toxicity questions that NPC designers will face.

items.title: MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture Deep Dive | Inside Unreal
items.excerpt: Epic's Inside Unreal deep dive on the new MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture plugin, which turns ordinary video from a phone or camera into full-body animation without mocap suits or markers.
items.rationale: Primary-source walkthrough of a tool animators can use right away: full-body animation from ordinary phone or camera video, with no suits or markers. This is the most hands-on pick in the pool.

items.title: 生成AIを活用したFMVゲーム「元カレ×デスゲーム」，2026年12月4日に基本プレイ無料で配信予定
items.excerpt: LIUGUANG STUDIO announced that its generative-AI-built live-action-style FMV game 'Ex-Boyfriend x Death Game', pitting the player against 100 exes on a cruise ship, launches free-to-play on December 4, 2026 (PC via Steam).
items.rationale: A dated Steam release of an FMV game built with generative-AI video, a format that AI makes cheap to produce. Adds an Asian outlet and a shipped-game angle to the set.

dedup.note: Dropped as duplicates: (1) Kotaku 'Student game dev competition shut down over AI slop' (11-10) is the same event as the PC Gamer card published 11-11 (history_match). (2) IGN and Eurogamer Binding of Isaac items are same-cluster (c0) duplicates of the Verge pick, one card per cluster. (3) Wccftech 'UE 5.9 Preview 2' is a running story: UE 5.9 Preview was published 11-11 (80.lv, history_match), and the 11-22 unrealengine.com card already covered UE 5.9's AI tooling (Python/MCP). Preview 2 is only an incremental build of the same release, so it was dropped rather than run as a follow-up. Not picked on score: GameRiv 'Clash Royale recruits AI cheat creator' (off-whitelist secondary outlet, a single anecdote in the AI-cheat theme carried 11-15).
